scope: Defined before first reranker run; provisional passage support, not answer correctness
requirements: SVM C and gamma explanations must both be present in top five, with at least one in top three
Imbalance / false-negative question must have directly useful evidence in top three
Exact heart RF, diamond PCA, diamond tree and lumbar logistic exercises must retain useful first results
DBSCAN point definitions must not rank below the existing rank two
All returned evidence lists must contain distinct content keys
No external inference; only pinned locally cached weights, without remote code
Check fresh questions without tuning on their returned results before promotion
